guidance.summary: 17% to 18% volume growth in FY27 mainly from Sanand facility
guidance.speaker: Anil Gupta
guidance.quote: We are expecting 17% to 18% volume growth in this current financial year, which will mainly coming from Sanand new facility.

guidance.summary: EBITDA margin expected between 10.5% to 11% on conservative side
guidance.speaker: Anil Gupta
guidance.quote: I mean on a conservative side, we can now expect around 11% -- anywhere between 10.5% to 11%.

guidance.summary: Export revenue to reach around 20% of total sales
guidance.speaker: Anil Gupta
guidance.quote: taking our export to around approximately 20% of our total sales in the current financial year, which is as per our previous target.

guidance.qualifier: capital expenditure for next 2 to 3 years
guidance.summary: Capital expenditure of INR600 crores to INR700 crores annually for next 2-3 years
guidance.speaker: Rajeev Gupta
guidance.quote: every year, we will be doing around INR600 crores to INR700 crores capital expenditure for next 2 to 3 years continuous.

guidance.summary: Expect around 20% growth in EHV segment this year
guidance.speaker: Anil Gupta
guidance.quote: This year, in EHV segment, we expect a growth of around 20%, a little bit from our existing factory because we are already operating at almost full capacity and some portion of growth will come from Sanand.
